items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Weinberg, I knew him, in Virginia. He used to do all those dates with the band in Virginia.

ctx.x: Then I knew certain guys in certain areas like -- oh, in Memphis, I knew Henry Jones, and I told Henry, well, Henry, how many dates can you handle, and Ralph Weinberg, I knew him, in Virginia. He used to do all those dates with the band in Virginia. And we'd tape maybe eight or ten dates. Then I'd tell Henry to contact a cat over in the

next state, so he'd go on over there and maybe set up over to Georgia or somewhere, some dates over there. Then he'd contact the guys in Florida. Used to have a two-spot, and they'd set up a few dates. So we made -- the last day of the tour, we stopped in Wichita, Kansas. So I told the fellows, well, fellows, I'm going on into Kansas City, and we just shut the group off, sent everybody home.
